paras: Pseudalsophis slevini , the banded Galapagos snake or Pinzon racer, is a species of snake of the family Colubridae. It is named for Joseph Slevin, a curator at the California Academy of Sciences.
The snake is endemic to Pinzon Island in the Galápagos Islands.
